title: Capsomnia
claim: Product Hunt: Capsomnia — Caps Lock keeps your Mac awake, even with the lid closed
why_good: Uses Caps Lock to keep a Mac awake even with the lid closed — a clever, memorable UX for a real (if tiny) need.
value: Cheap one-time Mac utility; niche, and the Caps Lock gimmick is the whole differentiation.
risk: Amphetamine/Caffeine own this; a one-trick utility easily replicated, and Apple could change power APIs.
evidence: Mac, Open Source, Developer Tools, GitHub
method: producthunt api v2 (top launches, last 2d) + startup-worthiness score

zh.claim: Product Hunt: Capsomnia —— 用 Caps Lock 让 Mac 合盖也保持清醒。
zh.why_good: 用 Caps Lock 让 Mac 合盖也不休眠——对一个真实(虽小)的需求,一个巧妙、好记的交互。
zh.value: 便宜的一次性 Mac 工具;细分,而 Caps Lock 的花招就是全部差异化。
zh.risk: Amphetamine/Caffeine 占据这块;单招工具易被复刻,Apple 也可能改电源 API。
